item.tib: dam 'gong bkar thabs srid pa'i brtar rdo
item.coloph: de ltar mdo smad sa yi thig ler chos rgyal sde dges bod yul bstan srid spi yi rim 'gro/ gu ru rin po che'i lung bzhin stobs chen mchod rten bzhengs shing grub mtha'i bla dgon mi 'dra ba shin tu mang por 'tshogs pa'i mdor na/ gnas dus ston 'khor phun sum 'tshogs pa'i de yi sna sel du dam 'gong glud rdzongs chen po'i mkho gal skabs su rtse mdo nas bris te/ bka' bab bdun gyi chu bo'i slob dpon shing rta'i mdzod 'chang gling chen bzhi yod pa'i shing rta chen po 'jams ('jam mgon kong sprul rin po che 'chi med gter gnyis g.yung drung gling par gzigs su phul bas/ tog (rtog) ges tshig dang ma 'dres par/ rdo rje'i tshigs su 'dug pas gzhan phan du spel dgos zhes gnang thabs bca' bas yig chung don tshangs su (tshang du) bgyis te brtsod dus rig pa 'dzin pa'i bla ma kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis gzhan phan du rtsom (brtsams) pa'o//
